notes: Corrected: the *when* of *And when they came* was marked `added`, but rule 55 makes a coordinator and a contiguous subordinator written together at a recast clause's left edge one rendering of the single waw, and rule 51 names that pair as its own limit. *And when* now aligns to `וַ` of `וַיָּבֹאוּ`, headed on *And*.
The waw of `וְהִנֵּה` remains `unrepresented`: the ASV writes no connective before *behold*.
